name: no cap
blurb: "No lie" or "for real": stresses that you are not exaggerating
title: No Cap Meaning: What Does No Cap Mean in Slang?
description: No cap means "no lie" or "for real". From Black slang, where to cap is to lie or brag, and Atlanta hip-hop. Cap and 🧢 mean the opposite. Examples.
answer: No cap means "no lie" or "for real". You add it to show you are not exaggerating: "that was the best burger I've ever had, no cap". It comes from Black American slang, where to cap means to lie, brag or exaggerate, and it is closely linked to Atlanta hip-hop; the 2017 track "No Cap" by Young Thug and Future helped spread it. Saying "cap" or posting a blue cap emoji means the opposite: that's a lie.

body: In Black slang, to cap about something has meant to brag, exaggerate or lie, a sense Dictionary.com dates back to the early 1900s. No cap therefore means without the lie. It appears on Twitter by at least 2012 and is closely associated with Atlanta hip-hop. Young Thug and Future's 2017 track "No Cap" made it far more widely known.

ul: "No cap, this is the best pizza in town."
"I ran five miles this morning, no cap."
"You finished the whole thing in one night? Cap 🧢."

sections.h: Cap, no cap and similar words

body: No cap is casual and upbeat, and like "literally" it is often used for emphasis rather than as a sworn statement. It is widely used by teens and young adults; older speakers using it can sound like they are trying too hard. Keep it out of formal writing.

faq.q: What does cap mean in slang?
faq.a: A lie or exaggeration. Saying "cap" or posting 🧢 means you think someone is lying.

faq.q: What does the blue cap emoji mean?
faq.a: It stands for "cap", a lie. "No 🧢" means no lie.

faq.q: Where did no cap come from?
faq.a: From Black American slang, where to cap means to lie or brag, and Atlanta hip-hop; Young Thug and Future's 2017 track "No Cap" helped spread it.
